Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.section1Content: SonicAI provides API credit management and top-up services. Credits are automatically added after successful Stripe payment.
Terms.section2Content: Note: Due to the nature of digital goods, all top-ups are final and non-refundable.
Terms.section3Content: Users are responsible for their own API keys. We are not liable for losses due to key leakage.
Terms.section4Content: We reserve the right to adjust pricing or service terms based on upstream providers.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.section1Content: We only collect necessary information: GitHub account, Stripe payment reference, and transaction history.
Privacy.section2Content: All payments are handled securely by Stripe. We do not store or process your credit card details.
Privacy.section3Content: We use essential cookies to maintain your login session.
Privacy.section4Content: We do not sell your personal data. Data is only shared with upstream providers and Stripe to complete transactions.
